'''Volume 40: Legends and Myths!''' is the 40th   volume of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga and the third and final volume in the {{MangaArc|Platinum}}. It is authored by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and illustrated by [[Satoshi Yamamoto]].

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume eleven of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Diamond and Pearl/Platinum".

==Blurb==
''The battle rages back and forth between the Distortion World and the regular world! Then, when Legendary Pokémon Giratina attacks Pearl, Dia intervenes with disastrous consequences! Meanwhile, Lady finds an unexpected ally in an unexpected location.''

''Will peace ever be restored to the Sinnoh Region...?!''

''Plus, spend time with lots of Pokémon including Blissey, Giratina, Regigigas, Slowking, Rotom, Shaymin, Cresselia, Magmortar, Electivire, Alakazam, Tangrowth and Arcanine!''

==Important events==
{{spoilers}}
* {{adv|Diamond}} and {{adv|Pearl}} battle [[Charon]] and {{p|Giratina}}.
* Diamond is hit by Giratina's {{m|Shadow Force}}, after which his body disappears.
* {{adv|Platinum}} enters the [[Distortion World]] through [[Sendoff Spring]] together with [[Palmer]], [[Mira]], [[Cheryl]], [[Riley]], [[Marley]], and the [[Advanced level Grunt]].
* Pearl, [[Dr. Footstep]], and the Sinnoh [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman enter the Distortion World.
* Diamond meets [[Cyrus]] in the Distortion World, and they free {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}}.
* Diamond, Pearl, Platinum, [[Paka and Uji|Paka, and Uji]] reunite, and the Advanced level Grunt returns the trio their Pokédexes.
* Giratina is defeated in [[Sunyshore City]].
* {{adv|Looker}} is called to the [[Unova]] region.
* Diamond receives a {{p|Manaphy}} {{pkmn|Egg}} from Looker.
